folded.id: those|who|disbelieve - it is all the same for them whether you warn them or do not warn them - they will not believe
folded.subject: those
folded.object: disbelieve - it is all the same for them whether you warn them or do not warn them - they will not believe

spans.text: Indeed, those who disbelieve - it is all the same for them whether you warn them or do not warn them - they will not believe.
And seek help through patience and prayer, and indeed, it is difficult except for the humbly submissive [to Allah] Who are certain that they will meet their Lord and that they will return to Him.
Or [it is] like a rainstorm from the sky within which is darkness, thunder and lightning.
Those are the ones who have purchased error [in exchange] for guidance, so their transaction has brought no profit, nor were they guided.

This is the Book about which there is no doubt, a guidance for those conscious of Allah - Who believe in the unseen, establish prayer, and spend out of what We have provided for them, And who believe in what has been revealed to you, [O Muhammad], and what was revealed before you, and of the Hereafter they are certain [in faith].
And when it is said to them, "Do not cause corruption on the earth," they say, "We are but reformers."
And when they meet those who believe, they say, "We believe"; but when they are alone with their evil ones, they say, "Indeed, we are with you; we were only mockers."

folded.id: whenever they|are|provided with a provision of fruit therefrom
folded.subject: Whenever they
folded.object: provided with a provision of fruit therefrom

spans.text: Whenever they are provided with a provision of fruit therefrom, they will say, "This is what we were provided with before."

folded.id: who break|the|covenant of allah after contracting it and sever that which allah has ordered to be joined and cause corruption on earth
folded.subject: Who break
folded.object: covenant of Allah after contracting it and sever that which Allah has ordered to be joined and cause corruption on earth

spans.text: And He misleads not except the defiantly disobedient, Who break the covenant of Allah after contracting it and sever that which Allah has ordered to be joined and cause corruption on earth.
But if you do not - and you will never be able to - then fear the Fire, whose fuel is men and stones, prepared for the disbelievers.

folded.id: will you|place|upon it one who causes corruption therein and sheds blood
folded.subject: Will You
folded.object: upon it one who causes corruption therein and sheds blood

spans.text: They said, "Will You place upon it one who causes corruption therein and sheds blood, while we declare Your praise and sanctify You?"
They said, "Exalted are You; we have no knowledge except what You have taught us.
And We said, "O Adam, dwell, you and your wife, in Paradise and eat therefrom in [ease and] abundance from wherever you will.
And [mention, O Muhammad], when your Lord said to the angels, "Indeed, I will make upon the earth a successive authority."
They said, "Will You place upon it one who causes corruption therein and sheds blood, while we declare Your praise and sanctify You?"
